name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-styles
description: Quartz 5 engine that fixes the cgc family layer's place in the cascade: emits `@layer cgc;` and nothing else. See README.md, CONTEXT.md and docs/adr/.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copy, never installed here: only its types are used, and esbuild erases them.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild compiles src/ to dist/, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside it (build.mjs). The library is a `workspace:*` spec, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-styles
quartz.description: Fixes the cgc family layer's place in the cascade: above core and themes. Every cgc-* plugin that emits CSS depends on it.
